How to use the Baishan Stormswords - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how to use the Baishan Stormswords. This is an absolutely deadly dual wield weapon, especially when you get both the Wind Sword and Thunder Sword buffs activated simultaneously. You can crank out some huge damage in a hurry, and it looks absolutely disgusting while you're doing it.

description:
How to use the Soft Snake Sword - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how to use the Soft Snake Sword. This is a pretty difficult weapon to use in my opinion. It's not overly complicated in its mechanics, but it can be very difficult to use the mechanics of this weapon in challenging fights. But it is so rewarding when you do so, and it has a more defensive playstyle revolving around timing.

How to use the Sundering Dual Axes - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how to use the Sundering Dual Axes weapon. This is an insanely good weapon in my opinion, and when you first start using it, you might think that it's not as good as it can be. But as you start upgrading this weapon, you really see the potential in it. And it's one of those weapons that also has maybe an option, an arranged option, which is great.
